items.title: Session log retention
items.question: How long should session logs be kept?
items.explanation: Logs fill the disk on small servers, but they are the only record of what an agent ran.
items.example: With 30 days, a chat from early October is gone by November.
items.recommendation: Keep 90 days: long enough to audit a release, short enough to bound disk use.

choices.label: Keep forever
choices.effect: Nothing changes; disk use keeps growing.

choices.label: Keep 90 days
choices.effect: Older logs are deleted nightly.

choices.label: Keep 30 days
choices.effect: Older logs are deleted nightly; audits reach back one month.

items.title: Autosave drafts
items.question: Should unsent drafts be saved automatically?
items.explanation: A draft survives a reload when it is saved.

choices.label: Save drafts
choices.effect: Drafts come back after a reload.

choices.label: Do not save
choices.effect: Drafts are lost on reload.

items.title: Crash reports
items.question: Should crash reports be sent?
items.explanation: Reports help find bugs; they contain stack traces only.
items.recommendation: Leave it off until the report format is reviewed.

choices.label: Send reports
choices.effect: Stack traces go to the crash service.

choices.label: Do not send
choices.effect: Nothing changes.
